note: 3-day reboot collapsed to 1 day. Revised blend — not a Day-1 clone. Pull + glute from Days 2–3 added; chop-heavy upper pair cut. Last hard data still 15 Aug. Train off the site even if Arnold is offline.

sessions.title: Full-Body Blend
sessions.goal: One session pulling the best pieces from the missed 3-day reboot: hinge + vertical pull + push + direct glute + single-leg option. Not Day 1 repeated.
sessions.success: Trap bar clean. Honest pull-up work logged. Glutes actually worked. Single-leg or goblet done without drama. Leave 2–3 in the tank.
sessions.note: Why this mix: Day 1 hinge kept. Day 2 pull-up + reverse-lunge option added. Day 3 hip thrust kept. Cut the redundant incline/row/goblet-only Day-1 shape. No BSS. MoveU L2 W3.

items.name: Glute Bridges
items.focus: Full squeeze. Ribs down. Prep for hip thrust.

items.name: Bodyweight Reverse Lunge check
items.focus: Front shin vertical. Any under-kneecap pinch → goblet later, skip reverse lunge.

blocks.title: Skill — Hinge + Pull Prep
blocks.note: Two patterns after time off: trap bar groove + honest pull assessment.

items.name: Trap Bar build-up
items.focus: Brace. Push floor away. Glutes finish. Control the lower.

items.name: Pull-up prep
items.detail: 2 × 3–5 scap pull-ups or slow negatives if full pull-up not ready
items.focus: Honest assessment — clean work only in Strength A.

exercises.name: Trap Bar Deadlift
exercises.prescription: 55–65 kg (earn 65 only if sets 1–2 are identical and easy)
exercises.focus: Every rep identical. Leave 2–3 in the tank.
exercises.note: 15 Aug peaked 70 then settled 60. Do not open at 70. Kept from Day 1 — highest-value hinge.

exercises.name: Cable Pallof Press
exercises.focus: Resist rotation. Exhale on press. Ribs stacked over pelvis.

exercises.name: Pull-up or Assisted Pull-up
exercises.prescription: BW, band-assist, or foot-assist as needed
exercises.focus: Full hang to chin clear. No kipping. Stop before form breaks.
exercises.note: From Day 2 — missing vertical pull was the main gap in the first redesign. Note assist method. Lat pulldown 3×8 moderate only if no pull-up setup.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Bench Press
exercises.focus: Full control. Soft landing. No bounce.
exercises.note: Push balance vs the pull-up. Kept light after layoff.

exercises.name: Barbell or Dumbbell Hip Thrust
exercises.prescription: Moderate — start light and earn load (e.g. 40–60 kg BB or heavy DBs)
exercises.focus: Chin tucked. Ribs down. Full glute squeeze at top. No lumbar overextend.
exercises.note: From Day 3 — direct glute work. Structural priority. Not optional filler.

exercises.name: Reverse Lunge or Goblet Squat
exercises.prescription: Lunge: BW–light DBs (6–12 kg) if warm-up check clean. Goblet: 16–22 kg if not.
exercises.focus: Lunge: front shin vertical, controlled knee to floor. Goblet: depth with knees tracking toes.
exercises.note: From Day 2 single-leg intent. Prefer reverse lunge if check was clean. Name variation in notes. No BSS.

exercises.name: Farmer Carry
exercises.focus: Walk tall. Soft ribs. Grip finishes the set, not form collapse.

blocks.title: Conditioning
blocks.note: Optional capacity touch. Skip if flat — MoveU still happens.

items.name: Bike
items.focus: Even hard efforts. Drop or skip if energy tanks.

blocks.title: MoveU Cool-down — Lordosis L2 W3
blocks.note: Still L2 W3. Consistency > novelty. No weight.

exercises.name: Deep Tissue: All Hip
exercises.focus: Slow pressure. Breathe. Don't force into pain.
exercises.note: Optional if time is tight — rotations + stretch are priority.

exercises.name: Side Lying Hip Lift Rotations
exercises.focus: Controlled rotation. Pelvis stacked. No lumbar flop.

exercises.name: Kickback Rotations
exercises.focus: Glute drives the kickback. Ribs quiet. Smooth rotation.

exercises.name: Double Leg Hip Rotations
exercises.focus: Low back stays calm. Move from hips, not spine.

exercises.name: TFL / Glute Med Stretch
exercises.focus: Breathe into the outside hip. No forcing.
